summary: File the hearing-loss example under sense 2
rationale: aḏnoṯi yaqiri is explicitly translated as ears becoming hard of hearing. Stem I sense 2 is (i=aḏno) schwerhörig werden, whereas its current sense 1 is the general schwerfällig werden, schwerer werden.
